verdict.reason: The help pages say scheduledTime must sit beside post, and when it is nested inside post it is ignored and the post publishes immediately, which matches what happened.

asked.item: why the post went live immediately

steps.text: scheduledTime must be a root-level field, a sibling of post, not inside it.
If scheduledTime is nested inside post, it is ignored and the post publishes immediately.
Use an ISO 8601 timestamp with a timezone offset for scheduledTime.
